parts.text:
Born from the final days of the Resistance, the Restoration stands as a symbol of what comes after the war depicted in _Forces_. When the conflict against Dr. Eggman finally ended, the world was left in pieces: towns lay destroyed, families had been scattered, and entire regions struggled to recover. Rather than disband, those who had fought for freedom chose to stay together and help rebuild the world they had fought to save.

Thus, the Restoration was formed.

The organization was initially led by Amy Rose, whose leadership had helped hold the Resistance together through its darkest days and into its earliest years of reconstruction. In time, however, command of the Restoration would pass to Jewel the Beetle, who would guide the organization as it evolved beyond its wartime roots.

Although the Restoration remains fully capable of defending itself, it is no longer an army. Its purpose has changed.

They are builders, medics, planners, scouts, engineers, and volunteers from every corner of the world. They travel from town to town repairing homes, clearing wreckage, restoring infrastructure, shutting down stray Badniks, and providing aid to anyone still suffering the consequences of Eggman's war.

The Restoration does not fight to win a war anymore.

It works to make sure there is a world worth having won it for.
parts.caption: IDW Cover - Nº45

parts.title: Past and Infection
parts.text: The Restoration was created as the successor to the Resistance after the war ended. With the Resistance disbanded, its former members and volunteers shifted their focus from fighting a war to rebuilding the world. The Restoration began repairing cities and communities damaged during the conflict, providing supplies, helping displaced civilians, and dealing with remaining threats left behind by Eggman's forces.

parts.title: Crisis City and Darkest Hour
parts.text:
The Restoration's humanitarian mission was severely tested when the Metal Virus outbreak began. As cities fell to the infection and people were transformed into Zombots, the organization shifted into emergency-response mode. Rescue teams evacuated civilians from infected areas, established shelters, transported refugees, distributed supplies, and coordinated with other groups to find survivors.

As the outbreak spread, Restoration facilities became increasingly important as safe zones. Its members conducted search-and-rescue missions while trying to keep infected individuals contained. The organization was forced to balance its humanitarian ideals with increasingly desperate measures to prevent the infection from spreading.

The Metal Virus eventually reached Restoration facilities themselves, turning their headquarters into a dangerous containment zone. An outbreak among refugees caused the situation to collapse, forcing the Restoration to evacuate its remaining personnel and civilians.

The evacuation came at a tremendous cost, with many people becoming infected while others sacrificed themselves to give the survivors time to escape. The Restoration ultimately lost its headquarters and was forced to abandon it entirely, scattering its surviving members and refugees.

The organization nevertheless continued its work, establishing temporary operations while searching for a way to survive the crisis.

With the world overwhelmed by Zombots, the Restoration and its allies gathered at their final major refuge. The crisis became a global battle against the forces controlling the Metal Virus, with the Restoration supporting the larger effort through evacuation, defense, logistics, and protection of civilians.

The conflict culminated in the Metal Virus being removed from the world. The infected were restored, bringing the immediate catastrophe to an end. However, the Restoration was left with the enormous task of helping people recover from the devastation.
parts.caption: Sonic IDW Cover - Nº19

parts.title: Test Run!
parts.text:
After the Metal Virus crisis, the Restoration returned to its original purpose: reconstruction. Its members faced enormous amounts of work, from rebuilding damaged communities to locating displaced people and organizing relief efforts.

Leadership also began changing during this period. The Restoration gradually transitioned away from its wartime origins, with greater emphasis being placed on administration, organization, volunteers, and long-term recovery.

A new generation of leadership began taking responsibility for the organization, while the Restoration's surviving members continued responding to threats whenever necessary.

The Restoration eventually established a new, larger headquarters and reorganized itself around a volunteer-based structure. The organization now had dedicated facilities, workshops, administrative areas, and other resources for coordinating reconstruction efforts.

Rather than functioning as a military force, the Restoration became a broad humanitarian network. It helped rebuild communities affected by the Metal Virus, searched for missing people, maintained infrastructure, and provided assistance to those still recovering from the war and its aftermath.

Although the organization could still mobilize fighters when necessary, combat was no longer its central identity.

The Restoration's rebuilding efforts were interrupted by renewed attacks from the Deadly Six. Several communities came under attack, forcing Restoration personnel to defend civilians and investigate the source of the attacks.

The threat eventually reached Restoration headquarters itself. The organization was forced to defend its own facilities while dealing with the kidnapping of one of its members.

Although the crisis was resolved and the Deadly Six were dealt with, the incident demonstrated that the Restoration remained vulnerable to major threats even after the Metal Virus crisis.
parts.caption: Sonic IDW Cover - Nº42

parts.title: Trial by fire
parts.text:
Following the Zeti crisis, the Restoration continued its reconstruction work while its members began facing personal changes and new responsibilities.

Some members temporarily stepped away from the organization because of outside threats, personal goals, or the need to pursue other paths. Others remained committed to Restoration work.

The organization consequently became less dependent on any particular group of individuals and increasingly relied on its wider network of volunteers and workers.

The Restoration began expanding beyond pure reconstruction and humanitarian relief by developing a rapid-response system. The idea was to have trained teams capable of reaching dangerous situations quickly, protecting civilians, and dealing with threats before they could escalate.

This represented a gradual evolution in the Restoration's role. It was still fundamentally a civilian organization dedicated to helping communities, but it recognized that protecting those communities sometimes required direct action.

The Restoration therefore began developing specialized teams while continuing its broader reconstruction efforts.
parts.caption: Sonic IDW Cover - Nº 57

parts.title: Phantom Riders
parts.text:
The Restoration attempted to expand its operations through partnerships with outside organizations. However, one such partnership eventually became a serious problem when its partner attempted to manipulate and exploit the Restoration for its own purposes.

The crisis exposed the dangers of trusting outside organizations without sufficient oversight. The Restoration was forced to deal with sabotage, deception, and an attempted takeover.

The incident ultimately ended the partnership and reinforced the need for the Restoration to remain careful about who it allowed into its operations.
The conflict surrounding the partnership escalated into a major incident involving a sabotaged race, criminal activity, and an attempt to seize control of a Restoration transport vessel.

The Restoration's resources were effectively turned against it, putting civilians, personnel, and an entire city at risk. The crisis culminated in an attempt to crash the hijacked vessel, forcing everyone involved to work together to evacuate the Restoration's headquarters.

The headquarters was ultimately destroyed.

The destruction was a major emotional and logistical blow to the organization. The building that had served as the center of its reconstruction network was gone, along with much of the infrastructure supporting its operations.

However, the Restoration itself survived.

The people who made up the organization were still there, and they immediately began helping one another and preparing to rebuild. The destruction of the headquarters demonstrated that the Restoration was not defined by a building, but by the people who volunteered, worked, and sacrificed themselves to help others.

groups.title: Team Sonic
groups.description: The legendary trio of Sonic, Tails, and Knuckles, combining speed, ingenuity, and strength to face major threats and protect those in need.

characters.name: Sonic the Hedgehog
characters.description: A fearless, free-spirited hero who values freedom above all else and races into danger whenever someone needs his help.

characters.name: Tails the Fox
characters.description: A brilliant young inventor and loyal friend whose technical expertise and quick thinking make him an invaluable member of Team Sonic.

characters.name: Knuckles the Echidna
characters.description: A strong-willed and powerful echidna who protects the Master Emerald and brings unmatched strength and determination to Team Sonic.

groups.title: Team Rose
groups.description: A compassionate team centered around Amy, Cream, Big, and Gemerl, combining heart, strength, and determination to help others and protect those who cannot protect themselves.

characters.name: Amy Rose
characters.description: A compassionate and determined optimist who inspires others with her courage, empathy, and unwavering desire to help those in need.

characters.name: Cream the Rabbit & Cheese
characters.description: A kind-hearted young rabbit and her loyal Chao companion, whose innocence, courage, and unwavering kindness often bring hope to those around them.

characters.name: Gemerl
characters.description: A powerful combat robot turned guardian, fiercely protective of Cream and her family while learning to understand friendship and compassion.

characters.name: Big the Cat & Froggy
characters.description: A gentle and easygoing fisherman with immense strength, who prefers a quiet life but is always willing to help his friends when trouble arises. Always searching for his companion Froggy

groups.title: Diamond Cutters
groups.description: A specialized Restoration team focused on rapid response and field operations, combining teamwork, combat skills, and determination to protect others and confront emerging threats.

characters.name: Tangle the Lemur
characters.description: An energetic and adventurous lemur with an incredibly versatile tail, whose enthusiasm, bravery, and loyalty make her a dependable ally and friend.

characters.name: Whisper the Wolf
characters.description: A quiet and highly skilled wolf who keeps others at a distance, but beneath her reserved nature lies a fiercely loyal and courageous protector.

characters.name: Lanolin the Sheep
characters.description: A determined and disciplined sheep who strives to keep others safe, bringing organization, leadership, and a strong sense of responsibility to the Restoration.

characters.name: Jewel the Beetle
characters.description: A diligent and compassionate beetle who keeps the Restoration running through careful organization, responsible leadership, and genuine care for its people.

characters.name: Belle the Tinketer
characters.description: A gentle and curious wooden robot who loves tinkering and helping others, carrying on her creator's legacy while searching for her own place in the world.

characters.name: Gadget Wolf
characters.description: A resourceful and hardworking member of the Restoration, always ready to lend a hand and put their practical skills to use wherever they are needed.
